rust.languageServer.description: Run rust-analyzer for Rust documents of trusted workspaces.

rust.analyzer.path.description: The rust-analyzer to run: a name looked up on PATH, or a path. Empty: rustup's in %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin or on PATH, for the workspace's toolchain (Settings > Languages adds its component).

rust.cargo.path.description: The cargo the Cargo tasks run: a name looked up on PATH, or a path. Empty: rustup's in %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin or on PATH, for the toolchain the workspace pins.
